description.value: Donair Affair is a BC-based fast-food chain approaching 25 years in operation, specializing in donair kebabs that blend Middle Eastern and Canadian flavors using beef, lamb, chicken, or falafel. The Maple Ridge location on Dewdney Trunk Road is one of more than 20 outlets across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley. It offers a casual sit-down atmosphere alongside takeout and online ordering, making it a convenient stop for a filling wrap or platter mid-ride.
